entries.en: to exchange; to swap, barter
to exchange; to change one thing for another
entries.notes: M栏音写污损难辨（T99，ee/eg 两读），释义依「易」字与西语 trocar。

entries.en: to substitute; to take another's place
entries.notes: M栏音写污损难辨（T99，fo/to/ro 诸读），释义依「代」字。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑为「贽」：初见所执之礼；一说「赘」：招赘、入赘女家
entries.en: damaged text, gloss uncertain: possibly 贽, the gift carried on a first presentation; or 赘, to marry into the wife's family
entries.notes: 西语行潦草（pagadores 处难辨）、字「贽/赘」两读、M栏音写污损（T99），无法定夺。

entries.zh: 送；递送、转交（或读「迭」，轮换对调）
entries.en: to deliver, pass on; (if 迭) to alternate — Sp. trocar oficio, to exchange an office or duty
entries.notes: 「送/迭」两读存疑，M栏 fier 对音不合；释义参西语 trocar oficio（对调差事）。

entries.zh: 脱；摆脱、脱去（换去坏的，换来好的）
entries.en: to shed, take off; to get rid of — Sp. to exchange the bad for the good
to turn, revolve; to transfer, pass from hand to hand
entries.notes: 西语 garbullos/garvullos 拼写存疑且词义不明，释义依「转」字。

entries.zh: 窃；偷窃〔该行潦草残损，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to steal (line badly faded; uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语整行难辨（残），字「窃/窍」两读，M栏中段残损，姑依「窃」字释为偷窃。

entries.en: to change (oneself), to alter — Sp. trocar se, mudarse
to change; to make a change, exchange
to change, to alter
to change one's appearance; to change in another manner
entries.notes: 西语 destra/de otra 拼写存疑（当作 de otra manera「以另一方式」），释义依「改头」。

entries.zh: 改面；改头换面、面目一新
entries.en: to change the face; to alter completely
entries.notes: 西语 otra 拼写潦草、M栏尾钩难辨；「改面」二字本身清晰。

entries.en: to change, correct, amend — Sp. corregir
to change, revise, correct
entries.notes: 西语 corregido/corregir 拼写存疑。

entries.zh: 交易；兑换（以银换零钱碎银）
entries.en: to trade, exchange; to change silver into small change (menuda)
entries.notes: M栏首词音写存疑且污损（T99）；「交易」与西语 plata por menuda（换零钱）互证。

entries.zh: 托易；托换、以银易他物（chapag~ 所指不明）
entries.en: to exchange silver for (chapag?, word unclear); to trade by entrusting
entries.notes: 西语 chapag/chapay 拼写存疑且词义不明，M栏 to/fo 两读；释义依「托」「易」二字。

entries.zh: 交取；互换取得（以金易他物而取之）
entries.en: to exchange and take in return — Sp. to trade gold for another thing
entries.notes: 西语第二行墨色极淡难辨（残），依「交」「取」二字释为互换取得。

entries.en: to replace, substitute, change out
entries.notes: 西语 seentabiadura/se en tabiadura 拼写存疑，释义依「替换」二字。

entries.en: to convert, exchange (gold for gold)
to exchange alternately; to replace in turn
